description: Dedicated tavern and inn fare traditions for nine cultures.

entries.title: Dwarven Tavern Fare
entries.summary: Heavy ale-soaked meals restore miners, warriors, and craftspeople after long underground shifts.
body: Menus feature Stonebread and ale stew, forge-grilled sausages, mushroom-butter Deepdelve Roast, stout-rich molten cheese, and charcoal-crusted Blackiron Pies.

entries.title: Elven Wayhouse Fare
entries.summary: Fresh herbal meals emphasize beauty, delicacy, fruit, flowers, nuts, and light broths.
body: Sylvan Salad, Moonbloom Tarts, Everleaf Soup, patterned Mistfruit platters, and Waybread with wildberry jam welcome travelers without weighing them down.

entries.title: Human Inn Fare
entries.summary: Warm, practical meals combine seasonal produce, preserved meat, bread, cheese, fish, and roasts.
body: Stew of the Day, meat-and-bread boards, pickled ploughman's lunches, Seafarer's Pie, and Rustic Roast serve farmers and weary travelers with familiar filling food.

entries.title: Gnomish Eatery Fare
entries.summary: Inventive bite-sized dishes arrange savory and sweet ingredients in playful mechanical forms.
body: Tinkerer's Tartlets, gear-shaped Cogs and Gravy, pressed Spiced Nut Bites, mushroom hand pies, and honeyed Clockwork Cakes reward curiosity as much as appetite.

entries.title: Orcish Mead Hall Fare
entries.summary: Intense meat-centered feasts support strength, endurance, and communal warrior culture.
body: Battle Boar platters, marrow-rich Bloodmeat Stew, bone-skewered meat and roots, broth tankards, and sausage-topped Warrior's Flatbread dominate the hall.

entries.title: Halfling Inn Fare
entries.summary: Warm hospitality arrives in generous portions of stew, pies, fruit desserts, apples, tea, biscuits, and jam.
body: Grandmother's Hotpot, hearth-baked meat pies, Sweetberry Crumble, honeyed apples, and tea platters make Halfling inns stabilizing centers of comfort and conversation.

entries.title: Dragonborn Fire-Pit Fare
entries.summary: Open-flame cookery produces intense, charred, spicy, protein-rich meals.
body: Flame-seared steak, smoked Ember Nuts, Inferno Fish Skewers, Volcanic Stew, and fire-salt Pepper Bread turn heat into both flavor and cultural display.

entries.title: Tiefling Den Fare
entries.summary: Smoky, exotic meals combine dark fruit, aromatic spice, beans, peppers, cheese, honey, and citrus.
body: Infernal Spice Roast, star-anise Ashen Flatbread, Darkfruit and goat cheese, smoked bean stew, and chili-honey nuts balance mystery with deliberate complexity.

entries.title: Lizardfolk Marsh Tavern Fare
entries.summary: Raw, dried, foraged, and nutrient-dense meals favor utility and natural ingredients.
body: Bogfish Tartare, insect-and-tuber cakes, sun-dried reptile strips, gelatinous Swampfruit, and concentrated broth gourds sustain travelers accustomed to marsh and wilderness life.
